text: ION supervised the construction of the engineering scale system by the CCS vendor (KMPS) as well as the BOP systems by the BOP engineering firm, S&L. This task covered the procurement, fabrication, construction, delivery, and acceptance testing. This task ended with the Site Acceptance Testing and the ownership transfer of the system to the ION. 4.3.1 Host Site Preparation ION worked with the host site organization to procure, fabricate, and install the BOP systems necessary to tie in the carbon capture system to the generating station: site work, flue gas, cooling water, steam/condensate, and electrical systems. Construction was managed by the BOP firm. 4.3.2 Carbon Capture System (CCS) Detailed Engineering ION and the CCS vendor completed the design activities that resulted in the Final Design Package. This included the finalization of the 3D model, detailed design packages from all engineering disciplines, the demonstration of compliance to system requirements, and the identification of long lead items. This subtask concluded with the generation of a Final Design Package. ION Clean Energy 9 DE-FE0031950: FINAL PROJECT REPORT 4.3.3 Fabrication of Carbon Capture System Modules ION procured the carbon capture system through the CCS vendor. The procurement and fabrication of the various components that made up the carbon capture system sub-systems and modules, including structural steel, columns, heat exchangers, pumps, filters, instruments, valves, and electrical components, were constructed by the vendor under the supervision of the ION. The vendor, with ION’s assistance, developed the process control software. ION verified the build by completing Factory Acceptance Testing of the carbon capture system sub- systems and modules when the work was complete. 4.3.4 Shipment of Modules ION oversaw and assisted in the planning, shipment and delivery of the modules to the host site. Shipment was arranged by the CCS vendor and coordinated for delivery with the ION, the host site, and the BOP engineering firm. 4.3.5 Modular Plant Installation and On-site Tie-Ins ION oversaw the BOP engineering firm, which erected the modules on site and performed the subsequent tie-ins to the BOP systems. 4.3.6 Site Acceptance Testing ION conducted Site Acceptance Testing according to the Test Plan to verify the operational condition of the engineering scale system and BOP systems. This Site Acceptance Testing involved commissioning tasks that were performed prior to the introduction of solvent chemicals. 4.4 Operational Preparation (BP2) 4.4.1 Solvent Procurement ION delivered the necessary quantity of baseline MEA solvent along with ICE-21™ and ICE- 31® solvents for use in the 10 tpd unit. The ICE-21™ and ICE-31® solvents were produced, packaged and delivered by a third-party custom manufacturer. Competitive bids were solicited for this activity. 4.4.2 Detailed Test Plan & Training ION developed the system shakedown and solvent test plans and reviewed them with the host site. ION provided on-boarding and training of operators for the system. 4.5 Testing of 1 MWe (10 tpd) NGCC Engineering Scale System (BP3) ION conducted the testing of the three solvents according to the test plan that was generated during Task 2 of the project.
